reason: I might try the free self-hosted version on a side project, but I am not paying $99 a month for a pre-alpha tool from one developer that runs agents unattended on our quota.
objection: A failed or looping run will burn our agent quota overnight and nobody notices. Nothing here tells me there are hard spend or retry caps, and if the one developer stops, we lose it.
would_change_my_mind: Hard per-run token and retry limits that stop a run and alert me, plus a few weeks of the free version producing PRs we actually merge.
